gloss: to cherish; to love dearly; to hold dear

definitions.gloss: to cherish; to love dearly; to hold dear
definitions.explanation: To feel deep affection and tenderness toward someone or something, treating them with care and devotion. Implies a gentle, enduring love rather than passionate emotion.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|いと}しむ{気持|きも}ち。
examples.english: The feeling of cherishing one's child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|いと}しむよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抱|だ}きしめた→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧。
examples.english: She held the small life tenderly, as if cherishing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{愛|いと}しむよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother tended to the flowers in the garden every day, cherishing them dearly.

notes:
A literary and poetic verb expressing tender, gentle love. Derived from the adjective ⟦{愛|いと}しい→愛しい：06170_itoshii⟧ (dear, beloved). More literary than ⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧ and conveys deeper emotional warmth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|いと}しむ: to cherish life
- ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|いと}しむ: to cherish one's child
- {愛|いと}しむよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as if cherishing; tenderly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慈|いつく}しむ→慈しむ：12629_itsukushimu⟧: to love tenderly; to be compassionate toward — very close synonym, slightly more formal
- ⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧: to treasure; to take good care of — more everyday
- {可愛|かわい}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to dote on; to be affectionate with — more casual and active

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (む row). Conjugates: {愛|いと}しまない, {愛|いと}しんで, {愛|いと}しみます.
